meta_description: Floors & 4 Walls is a Birmingham painter and decorator specialising in interior and exterior work. Free quotes, professional finish guaranteed. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Interior & Exterior Specialists — Birmingham & Surrounding Areas
hero_subhead: Professional painter and decorator in Birmingham. From feature walls to full interior refreshes, we deliver flawless finishes on time and on budget.
services_subhead: From preparation to finishing touches, we handle every aspect of interior and exterior decoration with care and precision.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Transform any room with fresh paint, wallpaper, or feature walls. We prepare surfaces properly so your new look lasts years, not months.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weather-resistant finishes that protect and enhance your home's exterior. We use trade-grade paint and work around your schedule.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert hanging of patterned or textured wallpaper, including tricky corners and alcoves. Finished to a professional standard every time.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Doors, skirting boards, window frames, and fitted furniture painted to a hard-wearing finish. We sand, prime, and topcoat for a smooth result.

services.title: Ceiling & Plasterwork
services.desc: Uneven ceilings, artex removal, and fresh emulsion work. We repair cracks and prepare surfaces so you get a perfectly smooth finish.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Shops, offices, and rental properties handled efficiently. We work flexibly around business hours and leave sites clean and dust-free.

about_pullquote: I'd rather spend an extra day preparing than rush and disappoint a customer.
about_para_1: Floors & 4 Walls was founded on a simple belief: proper preparation and quality materials make all the difference. For over 12 years, we've painted and decorated homes across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, earning a reputation for reliability and attention to detail. Every job, whether a single feature wall or a full house renovation, gets the same level of care.
about_para_2: Our customers choose us because we listen to what they want, show up on time, and finish when we say we will. We don't cut corners on prep work, and we're happy to answer questions about paint types, colours, and techniques. Many of our clients come back to us for repeat work, which says more than any advert ever could.

reviews.text: Had the entire downstairs done by Floors & 4 Walls. From day one they were professional and tidy. The attention to detail is brilliant—skirting boards, ceilings, everything spot on. Couldn't recommend them enough.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Used them for a feature wall and exterior refresh. The lads were friendly, worked efficiently, and the finish is perfect. No mess left behind either. Will definitely call them again for the kitchen next year.
reviews.author: Helen P.

reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish. They took time to explain what they were doing and matched the paint colour perfectly to samples I'd chosen. The prep work was thorough and it shows in the result. Fair pricing too.
reviews.author: David R.
